inputs.label: Ultima IV: Quest of the Avatar (free on GOG)
inputs.help: Your Ultima IV install folder from GOG, where it is free. QGPUI copies the whole folder.

steps.why: Android creates Android/data/com.SwivelChairGames.ANKHVR/files on the first launch.
Save files copied from a PC must be writable. The guide gives chmod 666 for copied .SAV files; find does the matching, because QGPUI quotes every argument, and succeeds when there are none.

steps.text: Open ANKH-VR from Library > Unknown Sources.

notes: File names are case sensitive on the Quest, so the push must keep their case. The asset is really named ANHK-VR.apk. Releases before 0.2.15 are pre-releases.
